description: This source file defines a utility function for ensuring a plugin is included in an allowlist within a configuration object. It exports 'ensurePluginAllowlisted' which updates the configuration to include a specific plugin ID if not already present.

methods.name: export function ensurePluginAllowlisted(cfg: OpenClawConfig, pluginId: string): OpenClawConfig { ensurePluginAllowlisted
methods.description: Ensures that a given plugin ID is included in the 'allow' list of plugins within the configuration object. If the plugin is already allowed or if the 'allow' list is not an array, it returns the original configuration; otherwise, it adds the plugin to the list and returns a new configuration object.
